data.what_it_does: Provides a common interface that platform-specific implementations of the flutter_background_service plugin must implement. It ensures consistency across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You need to create a custom platform implementation for flutter_background_service
You want to contribute to or modify the flutter_background_service plugin
avoid_when: You only need to use the flutter_background_service plugin without custom platform code
You are looking for a full background service implementation
strengths: Ensures type safety and consistency across platforms
Simplifies plugin development by providing a clear contract
weaknesses: Requires understanding of Flutter platform interfaces
Not useful if you only use the existing plugin
